# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Lienzo is currently in early development. Security fixes are provided for the
latest published release only.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| Latest release | Yes |
| Older releases | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/poncho-ajmv/Lienzo/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue for a vulnerability that has not been fixed.

Include the affected version and operating system, steps to reproduce the
problem, its possible impact, and any suggested mitigation. Reports should not
contain secrets or personal data that are not necessary to reproduce the issue.

You should receive an acknowledgment within seven days and an initial
assessment within fourteen days. These are best-effort response times for an
individually maintained project.

Please allow time for a fix and coordinated disclosure before publishing
technical details. Credit will be given in the release notes if requested.
